content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in the 1-3 day window post-peak.
- Underestimate when sentiment is strongly bullish (sentiment > 0.6) but price is trending upward — model lags in confirming momentum.
- When sentiment is bearish (sentiment < 0.4), model often underreacts to downward pressure — forecast remains too high.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs and underweights lows — correct by smoothing 3-5 day moving average before forecasting.
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently overpredicts by 0.5–2.5% in early periods (days 1–7) when sentiment is neutral or slightly bullish.
- If sentiment is rising (increasing over last 3 days), model should reduce forecast slope — avoid accelerating upward trend.
- If sentiment is falling (decreasing over last 3 days), model should reduce forecast magnitude — avoid overcorrection downward.
